text_block_list.text:
One day, while out and about
with Neo Universe...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Looking where Neo Universe pointed, I saw a claw machine filled with plushies themed after Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Looking at "starchild"...
makes my "vitals" show abnormal readings...
Is this... "heart throbbing"?

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
“But... ‘MIP’. Neo Universe
does not know the ‘trajectory’ to obtain it...”

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"I want the plushie, but I don't know
how to win it..." Is that what they're trying to say?
choice_data_list: In that case, leave it to me.

text_block_list.text:
